scope: G13 and G15 complete mandatory assertion inventory
rules: Do not mark an assertion verified from a scenario-level green status alone
Only exact-SHA executed behavior and independent source inspection can close automated assertions
Policy and independent review assertions cannot be auto-approved by CI
Unreconciled and missing assertions are acceptance blockers
Explicit FULLY_TESTED claims require passing same-SHA witnesses and source review of each atomic clause
PARTIALLY_TESTED never counts as acceptance closure even when all attached candidate tests pass
MANUAL_REVIEW must never be promoted to automatic PASS
